content.title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation - Reviewers
declarations: Payment from healthcare industry to department/institution for personal services: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member.

Research funding: European Union Horizon2020 (different EU projects, project partner, project lead); British Heart Foundation (different research grants, project leader, senior fellow); NIHR (funding for the RATE-AF trial, supervisor for fellowship); Leducq Foundation (genomics and AF network, PI); UK Medical Research Council (project co-lead, coapplicant); German Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) support for clinical trials.

Industry support for trials and roles: Abbott (support for EAST - AFNET 4, chief investigator); Sanofi Aventis (support for EAST - AFNET 4, chief investigator); Daiichi Sankyo (support for NOAH - AFNET 6, Chief Investigator).
Membership/affiliation: speaker of the board of AFNET and membership/affiliation in political or advocacy groups working in cardiology.
Patents: The UKE holds two patents related to atrial fibrillation; expert is listed as an inventor; no licensing or royalties.
content.notes: Declaration covers relationships reported to ESC during yearly call for declaration covering previous calendar year (period of guideline development up to and including 2023).
